# The OpenDoc edit vocabulary, version 1.5

64 commands in 14 families. 14 can be tracked suggestions, 47 are refused in suggest mode with the published reason, and 3 are not content edits (comments and review decisions). They are the agent-side twins of 104 editor command ids; 84 editor ids that can change a document are not exposed to agents, each with a reason (`commands.json` `uiNotExposed`).
